authorization.decision: adopt semantic movement completeness as a development standard for the functorial successor migration and synchronize the target Goal thread; adopt model routing for mechanized development as part of the same standard

additive_to: 06 phase gates P1 P3 P4 P5

mandatory_input_consumers: P1 facility and capability migration eligibility audit
disposition_rule: every movement record has exactly one disposition from allowed_dispositions; free-text disposition is forbidden

blocked_actions: generator or parallel-worker output treated as promotion
unassigned_blocker_gate.closure_rule: cell/file/test/hash closure cannot replace movement closure; green tests and exact hashes prove declared scope only

locator_separation.unwired_rule: contract-only unwired or disabled semantic capabilities must be placed declared-lost or rejected; they must not be deleted for lacking a live owner

requires: every movement record has all required fields
every disposition is one of the six allowed values
movement matrix rows are unique and traceable to tests or review notes
locator counts are labeled as locator evidence not completeness
every semantic capability in declared scope has a movement record or explicit rejection record
no capability is dropped because it lacks a live owner
at least one legacy end-to-end trace maps to a target trace
at least one failure or reverse-return case is traced end to end
at least one declared loss or explicit zero-loss declaration
green tests and exact hashes are not presented as proof of capability preservation

review_rule: both independent review gates must pass; reviewing declared scope without predecessor-to-successor inventory is not a pass
generator_rules: generators and parallel workers may consume only a spec that has passed the completeness gate
generators must not solidify omissions into schema
worker completion is evidence a bounded job finished, not that a capability moved or promotion is authorized
worker output that adds removes or rewrites semantic capabilities must be folded back into the movement inventory before any promotion gate

c7_minimum_semantic_chain.decision_rule: exactly one alternative selected by DigestionDecision is executed; ordered_prefix, the selected alternative, and ordered_suffix keep directed order; alternatives are not serial and are not assumed commutative
c7_minimum_semantic_chain.boundary_rule: C7 owns raw-content structuring through admission; C8 starts typed knowledge from structured or admitted material and must not absorb raw-content structuring
c7_minimum_semantic_chain.edge_rule: every chain edge needs a movement record with source evidence and target acceptance trace; a missing edge is UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER even if every cell has a locator
c7_minimum_semantic_chain.admission_rule: C7.2 Verify|Admit is a semantic gate, not a file existence check

requirements: generate legacy/donor semantic movement inventory and successor movement matrix
complete legacy decision parity for STRUCTURED_JSON long-report derived-report pass-through

retrospective_backfill.blocker_rule: UNASSIGNED_BLOCKER found by backfill blocks only promotion or candidate acceptance that depends on it; no fabricated global rollback

model_routing.deepseek_output_gate: output must pass mainline completeness and promotion review before any promotion gate

authority_exclusions: no self-proof of P4 or C7 completion

resume_gate.resume_boundary: semantic movement completeness gate before P4 capability-spec pilot
